snippet.title: Derelikt - Release Date Announcement Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
DERELIKT ( https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10020388) is coming to PlayStation 5 on November 13, 2026. Experience a first-person narrative retro FPS shooter built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror. Explore sprawling halls full of enemies, solve environmental puzzles, and make use of an array of weapons to survive.

#ps5 #ps5games
